description: This file contains unit tests for Discord inbound context helper functions, using the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions related to building and checking access contexts in a Discord integration, including guild and direct message handling, role and username-based access control, and context construction.

methods.name: createDiscordSupplementalContextAccessChecker
methods.description: Creates a function to check if a user is allowed to access supplemental context based on roles or username match.

methods.name: buildDiscordGroupSystemPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a system prompt string for Discord group contexts, stripping excess whitespace.

methods.name: buildDiscordInboundAccessContext
methods.description: Builds access context object for inbound Discord messages based on channel configuration and message metadata.

methods.name: buildDiscordUntrustedContext
methods.description: Constructs untrusted context array for direct messages, including the channel topic and message body.
